messages:
Alex Kim: FYI we saw a small spike of 429s in eu-west causing duplicate creates from the JS SDK after token refreshes.

Maya Rao: is this the token-refresh -> replay cascade?

Ben Turner: yes, logs show refresh then immediate replay that hits 429. sample: 2026-08-01T14:03:10Z client req id=a1 status=200; 14:03:11Z auth refresh ok; 14:03:11Z replay id=a1 status=429 retry-after=1

Sylvia Chen: two issues: SDK parity (node retries POSTs by default, other SDKs require X-Idempotency-Key) and 429 responses lacking structured hints.

Alex Kim: short-term mitigate on server: add duplicate-suppression window (~10s) and include JSON 429 body with retry_after + safe_to_replay.

Maya Rao: SDK change: default to conservative replay policy for non-idempotent routes. Only auto-replay if X-Idempotency-Key present or allow_unsafe_replay explicitly enabled.

Ben Turner: backoff: use full jitter per attempt, base 200ms, cap 5s, max attempts 4 for mutate ops. Honor Retry-After header when present.

Sylvia Chen: add telemetry tag when SDK blocks an unsafe replay (metric: unsafe_replay_blocked) and trace idempotency_key when present.

Alex Kim: action items: 1) server 429 JSON + dup-suppress window, 2) SDKs (node/go/python) default replay_policy=conservative, 3) full jitter backoff cap 5s, 4) telemetry for blocked replays, 5) update onboarding/docs.

Maya Rao: I'll open cross-repo issue and add PR checklist. tagging eng-runtime and devex.

Ben Turner: I'll implement server header change and add multi-region failover tests.

CI Bot: staged build release/edge-safe-replay-2026.08.01-rc1 deployed :white_check_mark:

Sylvia Chen: recommended client snippet:

// JS: attach idempotency key for creation
const headers = { 'X-Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(), Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
await client.post('/v1/resources', body, { headers, retry: { policy: 'conservative', maxAttempts: 4, backoff: 'full_jitter', capMs: 5000 } })

Alex Kim: I'll push SDK PRs for parity this afternoon and include migration notes. will paste links when ready. :rocket:
